description: Load one member's full profile — title, company, tags, clicked URLs, engagement percentile, at-risk state and bot detection. Use for pre-call briefs and to enrich a shortlist.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

subscriberHash.description: The member's Mailchimp-style lowercase MD5 subscriber hash (canonical member key).

name: sm_get_member

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_member tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

activityTimeline.description: The member's raw activity events in time order.

items.description: Chronological list of all actions taken by a member.

activityType.description: Kind of tracked action, for example open, click, or subscribe.

campaignId.description: Stable identifier for a Mailchimp campaign. Use it to join rows across tools or drill into sm_get_campaign.

campaignTitle.description: The human-readable title of the campaign. May be null when Mailchimp has no title set.

url.description: The clicked or referenced URL, or null when absent.

atRiskStatus.description: Evaluation of churn risk based on activity fall-off. May be null.

activeActionsPrior.description: Count of engagement actions in the prior comparison window.

activeActionsRecent.description: Count of engagement actions in the recent comparison window.

isAtRisk.description: True when the member's recent activity has collapsed relative to prior activity.

audienceAverages.description: Comparative audience averages for context against an individual member. May be null.

botDetection.description: Metrics for suspected automated bot activity. Note: this object is only present when bot activity was detected. May be null.

botActivityCount.description: Tracked actions attributed to suspected bots.

botGroupCount.description: Number of suspected bot groups detected.

totalActivities.description: Total tracked actions for the member.

campaignConsistency.description: How consistently this member engages compared to standard. May be null.

avgCampaignsEngaged.description: Average campaigns engaged with across the audience.

totalCampaigns.description: Total campaigns in the comparison window.

campaignResponses.description: Per-campaign response rows for this member.

items.description: Individual member response data to a specific campaign.

campaignClickRate.description: Click rate for the specific campaign in the enclosing row.

campaignId.description: Stable identifier for a Mailchimp campaign. Use it to join rows across tools or drill into sm_get_campaign.

campaignOpenRate.description: Open rate for the specific campaign in the enclosing row.

didClick.description: True when the member clicked in this campaign.

didOpen.description: True when the member opened this campaign.

emailsSent.description: Number of emails the campaign attempted to send to recipients.

firstOpenMinutes.description: Minutes between send and the member's first open, or null when never opened.

subjectLine.description: The campaign subject line as sent.

clickedUrls.description: URLs the member has clicked with click counts.

items.description: URLs clicked by this specific member.

clickCount.description: Number of times the member clicked the enclosing URL.

url.description: The clicked or referenced URL, or null when absent.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

engagementByHour.description: Member's tracked actions bucketed by hour.

items.description: Activity heatmap buckets for an individual member.

activityCount.description: Number of tracked actions in the enclosing bucket.

engagementProfile.description: Calculated overall engagement statistics for an individual member. May be null.

engagementRank.description: Ordinal rank of the member by engagement, or null.

engagementScore.description: Composite engagement score for the member or cohort. Note: Leader rows use a 0-100 percentile, while at-risk rows use a raw time-decayed score that can be negative.

isLeader.description: True when the member qualifies as a leader by engagement.

leaderEngagementRank.description: Null for non-leaders via LEFT JOIN.

memberRating.description: Integer engagement rating for the member, or null.

totalClicks.description: Total click events, counting repeat clicks.

totalOpens.description: Total open events, counting repeat opens by the same member.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

memberProfile.description: Core profile information for an individual member. May be null.

businessType.description: The member's business type or category, or null when unset.

companyName.description: The company associated with the member, or null when unknown.

countryCode.description: Two-letter country code for the member, or null when unknown.

countryName.description: Full country name for the member, or null when unknown.

dimensionFour.description: Fourth custom dimension value for the member, or null.

dimensionOne.description: First custom dimension value for the member, or null.

dimensionThree.description: Third custom dimension value for the member, or null.

dimensionTwo.description: Second custom dimension value for the member, or null.

firstName.description: The member's first name, or null when unavailable.

language.description: The member's preferred language, or null when unknown.

lastName.description: The member's last name, or null when unavailable.

memberRating.description: Integer Mailchimp engagement rating for the member (1-5), or null when unrated.

memberTimezone.description: Timezone string as reported by Mailchimp for the member, or null. Passed through unvalidated and frequently wrong or missing — prefer companyName, state and email domain for locale inference.

region.description: Region or state-level location string, or null when unknown.

repName.description: Internal owner or rep assigned to the member, or null when unassigned.

state.description: State or province string, or null when unknown.

stats.description: Raw Mailchimp member-stats JSON as an unparsed string that the client must parse itself.

status.description: Subscription status, for example subscribed, unsubscribed, cleaned, or pending.

title.description: The member's job title, or null when unknown.

vip.description: True when the member is flagged VIP.

monthlyTrend.description: Per-quarter (or month) trend rows for the diagnostic period.

clicks.description: Click-events count observed over the enclosing window.

opens.description: Open-events count observed over the enclosing window.

total.description: Combined open plus click events for the member in the month.

projectId.description: An opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters identifying a Space Monkey Project. Treat this value as entirely opaque; do not parse, sequentialize, or auto-generate it.

subscriberHash.description: The 32-character lowercase hex MD5 hash of the member's downcased email address. This is the canonical unique identifier for members exposed across the Enterprise API, identical to Mailchimp's core behavior. The API will never expose internal synthetic BigQuery UUIDs.

title: Get member profile
